dashboard.title: Emissions Overview
dashboard.emptyTitle: No emission data for this period yet
dashboard.emptyDescription: Upload utility/fuel invoices or import from an Excel template to calculate emissions.

dashboard.noFootprints: No product figures yet. Enter production output for the period to allocate emissions to each product.
dashboard.statEvidencedHint: weighted by CO₂e, not by row count
dashboard.scopeDesc: Period emissions split by the three GHG Protocol scopes: on-site fuel, purchased energy, and the supply chain.

scopeMeaning.scope1: Fuel burned on site and in company vehicles

dashboard.monthlyDesc: Each column is one month total, split by scope, so you can see which month rose and why.
dashboard.sourcesDesc: The largest emission sources of the period; colour shows the scope. Start reducing from the longest bar.
dashboard.evidenceDesc: Share of emissions proven by invoices or imported files versus typed in by hand. EU buyers and CBAM prefer documented data.
dashboard.productDesc: Emissions allocated to each unit of product by output, split by origin. This is the figure printed on the green passport.

hero.title: Carbon reporting for export factories
hero.subtitle: Enter electricity, fuel and material invoices and bills of lading. EcoTrace calculates Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions with sourced factors and keeps the original document behind every figure.

docs.title: Every figure traces back to a document
docs.body: Upload an invoice and key in a few fields next to the original. Units, dates and emission factors are checked before saving, then emissions are calculated straight away.

passport.title: A green passport for each product
passport.body: Period emissions are allocated to each product by output. Once the period is locked, every passport gets a public verification code, hashed with SHA-256 and signed with ECDSA P-256, so buyers can check the figures were not changed.

periods.title: Work by period, with the right people
periods.p1d: Each factory has its own periods and grid emission factor.
periods.p2d: Locked figures stop changing and can be issued as passports.
periods.p3d: Owners, editors and viewers get different permissions.
